title: Nightshift investigations
description: Investigations by severity, each a click away from its detail, a Create case action and its conversation.

body.query: FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE in_progress == true | STATS in_progress = COUNT(*)

children.query: FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity == "critical" AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | STATS investigations = COUNT(*)

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity == "high" AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | STATS investigations = COUNT(*)

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity == "medium" AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | STATS investigations = COUNT(*)

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity == "low" AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | STATS investigations = COUNT(*)

body.query: FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | SORT created_at DESC | LIMIT 100 | KEEP id, title, summary, created_at, in_progress, severity, entities, status, agent_id

children.query: FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE id == ?selected_id | KEEP severity, status, verdict, entities, created_at
